sources.title: Bonsai-4B-gguf: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview Bonsai-4B-gguf is an end-to-end 1-bit quantized language model developed by prism-ml that runs on llama.cpp with support for CUDA, Metal, and CPU backends. The model contains 4.0 billion parameters (approximately 3.6 billion non-embedding) based on the Qwen3-4B architecture with 36 Transformer decoder blocks, grouped query attention with 32 query heads and 8 key-value heads, SwiGLU ...

sources.title: Bonsai 4B - Bonsai - docs.prismml.com
sources.snippet: Bonsai 4B targets edge deployments where the bigger Bonsai models don't fit or where you need headroom for other workloads. At 0.57 GB (1-bit), the weights are small enough to power applications on wearables, and mobile devices.
